title: Array Division
statement:
Use binary search on the answer to divide a nonnegative array into exactly k nonempty contiguous parts, minimizing the largest part sum.

Input
n k, followed by n nonnegative integers.

Output
Print the optimal largest sum.

Constraints
1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 200000. Each value is at most 10⁹.
